verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS risk platform, but no evidence documents any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The only related item describes optionally adding the fraud data-collection SDK to more website pages. That is a different feature about shopper data for risk scoring, not a user opt-out of product telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
